description: Address v2 review feedback (iteration 2): Fix fallback double-concat audio, wire dir_positive into Guide pass 1, update stale docstrings, and add clarifying CLIP comment.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix fallback double-concat audio: In generate_chunk(), when dir_video_latent is None (fallback path), set audio_latent_for_concat = None instead of dir_audio_latent, since build_empty_latents already fuses video+audio internally.

STEP 2 - Wire dir_positive into pipeline: When dir_positive is not None (Director path), run ConditioningZeroOut + LTXVConditioning on dir_positive to produce timeline-aware pos/neg conditioning, and feed THAT to run_director_guide() for pass 1 instead of plain pos_cond/neg_cond.
STEP 3 - Fix stale docstrings: Update separate_av_latent docstring and generate_chunk docstring step 15 to say output_index=0 (the output) instead of output_index=1 (denoised_output).

STEP 4 - Add CLIP LoRA comment: In build_director_conditioning, add a comment explaining that CLIP stays unmodified because all LoRAs in this workflow are model-only (distilled, transition, mvcamera, omninft) and do not modify CLIP weights.
acceptance_criteria: Python file passes py_compile and ast.parse without errors
Fallback path sets audio_latent_for_concat = None when dir_video_latent is None
When dir_positive is not None, ConditioningZeroOut + LTXVConditioning produces conditioning fed to Guide pass 1
CLIP LoRA comment is present in build_director_conditioning
findings: All 4 review issues addressed: (1) Fallback path now sets audio_latent_for_concat=None since build_empty_latents already fuses AV internally, preventing double-concat; (2) dir_positive is now routed through ConditioningZeroOut + LTXVConditioning to produce timeline-aware pos/neg conditioning that feeds Guide pass 1, matching the workflow signal path (nodes 128+27); (3) Both docstrings updated to correctly document output_index=0 for both passes; (4) Added comment explaining CLIP stays unmodified because all LoRAs are model-only. Issue 5 (output_index=0 vs 1) required no code change as the code already correctly follows the workflow JSON.
